main_body: Farm ground patch: golden crop/straw rows at top, a grass band, then tilled brown soil rows with grass sprouts, laid as a flat terrain block.
top_band: none; terrain tile patch with no standing body (golden crop field rows 0-14, grass band 16-21, soil rows 22-46)
evidence: Terrain ground patch, not a standing object. The 3/4 contract for standing objects does not apply. It reads as a ground autotile block with a top crop strip and tilled soil furrows, with no isometric side faces. Accepted as terrain.

style.evidence: Candidate carries many tones per material: the crop strip has speckled yellows/olives/cream, the grass has 4-5 greens with blade clumps, and the soil has several browns with lighter clods and sprouts. Dark edges are dark brown or dark green, tinted to the adjacent material, not neutral black. There are no large flat fills, and the texture is dense and richer than the reference grass and paving.
